scenarios.name: first-entry
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: WS-COMM-AREA initialised, the map sent ERASE with the cursor on ACCNO; RETURN TRANSID('ODAC') LENGTH(102)

scenarios.name: pa1
scenarios.why: PA1: CONTINUE, nothing sent; RETURN TRANSID with the COMMAREA

scenarios.name: pf3
scenarios.why: PF3: RETURN TRANSID('OMEN') IMMEDIATE: back to the main menu

scenarios.name: pf12
scenarios.why: PF12: SEND-TERMINATION-MSG, RETURN

scenarios.name: clear
scenarios.why: CLEAR: SEND CONTROL ERASE FREEKB, RETURN

scenarios.name: mapfail
scenarios.why: ENTER with no field modified: RM010 -- ABNDPROC LINKed (an ABNDFILE record) and ABEND HBNK

scenarios.name: other-key
scenarios.why: PF7: WHEN OTHER -- 'Invalid key pressed.', SEND MAP DATAONLY ALARM (PF5 is this screen's delete key)

scenarios.name: inquire
scenarios.why: ENTER with account 1: BIF DEEDIT, LINK INQACC (run in the task) with the program's own INQACC-COMMAREA, the account shown and 'If you wish to delete the Account press <PF5>.'; the inquiry's fields go back in WS-COMM-AREA (INQACC-EYE 'ACCT')

scenarios.name: inquire-mortgage
scenarios.why: ENTER with account 5, a MORTGAGE with a negative balance

scenarios.name: inquire-not-found
scenarios.why: ENTER with account 50: INQACC 'N', type blank, rate 0 -- 'Sorry, but that account number was not found.', the fields blanked; WS-COMM-AREA initialised (INQACC-EYE not 'ACCT')

scenarios.name: inquire-no-account
scenarios.why: ENTER with ACCNO left empty (ACCNOL 0): 'Please enter an account number.', no DEEDIT, no LINK; PARMS-SUBPGM initialised

scenarios.name: inquire-deedited
scenarios.why: ENTER with '0000-002': BIF DEEDIT leaves 00000002, account 2 is shown

scenarios.name: delete
scenarios.why: PF5 after an inquiry of account 2 (the COMMAREA carries its sort code and number): VALIDATE-DATA passes, ACCNO2 through NUMVAL (fixed point), LINK DELACC with PARMS-SUBPGM (run in the task: the ACCOUNT row deleted, a PROCTRAN 'ODA' row) -- 'The account ... was successfully deleted.', the fields blanked

scenarios.name: delete-loan
scenarios.why: PF5 deleting account 3, a LOAN

scenarios.name: delete-not-found
scenarios.why: PF5 for account 50 (gone since the inquiry): DELACC 'N' / '1' -- 'Sorry, but that account number was not found.'

scenarios.name: delete-null-statement
scenarios.why: PF5 for account 4, whose last-statement date is NULL: DELACC's SELECT fails (-305): DELACC ABENDs HRAC in the task

scenarios.name: delete-without-inquiry
scenarios.why: PF5 with no inquiry first (the COMMAREA's sort code and account zero): 'Please enter an account number.', no LINK

scenarios.name: first-entry-send-map-invmpsz
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: the SEND MAP ERASE of the empty map fails INVMPSZ (planned, X71): nothing is sent and the non-NORMAL arm takes the abend routine

scenarios.name: validation-failure-send-map-tsioerr
scenarios.why: the inquire-not-found input sends its message with SEND MAP DATAONLY ALARM, which fails TSIOERR (planned, X71): the non-NORMAL arm takes the abend routine

scenarios.name: account-not-numeric
scenarios.why: ACCNOI '0000000B': the trailing letter keeps its zone through BIF DEEDIT, so the field is NOT NUMERIC and the validation message is sent

scenarios.name: link-inqacc-pgmiderr
scenarios.why: inquiry of account 5, but the LINK INQACC fails PGMIDERR: the non-NORMAL arm after the LINK

scenarios.name: link-delacc-pgmiderr
scenarios.why: PF5 delete of account 2, but the LINK DELACC fails PGMIDERR

scenarios.name: delete-sql-fails
scenarios.why: PF5 delete of account 2: DELACC's DELETE FROM ACCOUNT fails -530, so it returns DEL-SUCCESS 'N' with fail code '3'

scenarios.name: pf12-send-text-tsioerr
scenarios.why: PF12: SEND-TERMINATION-MSG's SEND TEXT ERASE FREEKB (STM010) fails TSIOERR (planned, register X71): nothing is sent and the non-NORMAL arm takes the abend routine

scenarios.name: first-entry-plain-return-invreq
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: the closing RETURN TRANSID .. COMMAREA RESP (A010) fails INVREQ RESP2 4 (planned: IBM's TRANSID in a program associated with an APPC logical unit, register X71) -- the program goes on to its A010 abend routine

notes: CBSA's display / delete-account screen (BNK1DAC, transaction ODAC, BMS map BNK1DA of mapset BNK1DAM: the symbolic map is generated from src/base/bms_src/BNK1DAM.bms, @bms/BNK1DAM.cpy). Pseudo-conversational, as every CBSA screen (PF3 RETURN TRANSID('OMEN') IMMEDIATE from the stated terminal T001, oracle_assumptions.md X27). ENTER inquires (BIF DEEDIT of the account number, LINK INQACC with its INQACC-COMMAREA, the trailing POINTER NULL) and shows the account, keeping it in WS-COMM-AREA; PF5 checks the COMMAREA's sort code and account number from that inquiry and LINKs DELACC with PARMS-SUBPGM (three POINTERs set NULL). INQACC, DELACC and ABNDPROC run in the task, as in cbsa-inqacc / cbsa-delacc. The COMMAREA compared is the one the program RETURNs, WS-COMM-AREA (LENGTH 102); a returning task's COMMAREA is given in that layout (the program's DFHCOMMAREA is the same 102 bytes). ACCOUNT, PROCTRAN and ABNDFILE are compared after every scenario. Not reached: an account number with no digit after BIF DEEDIT (not modelled: refused), DELACC's fail code 2 (code 3, 'a delete error', is reached by an enumerated SQL fault, #4173), and the failure branches after SEND MAP / SEND TEXT / SEND CONTROL / RETURN / LINK (no fault can be injected on them). Data: seed.sql is cbsa-delacc's (SYNTHETIC).
